libOPNMIDI v1.6.2 (715931e, 2026-08-24) — https://github.com/Wohlstand/libOPNMIDI
Vendored: src/ (without the GX and PMDWin cores, disabled upstream, the LLE
cores and the VGM dumper), include/, licences, fm_banks/ (gm.wopn was a
symlink to xg.wopn: dropped).
Rewamp files live in rewamp/:
  opnmidi_rename.h  generated by scripts/gen_fm_midi_rename.py
                    (nm -gU of the library | --api opn2_ --prefix rwopn_)
  opnmidi_banks.c   generated by scripts/gen_opn_banks.py (the library embeds
                    no bank; index order is persisted, only ever APPEND)
  opnmidi_scope.h   oscilloscope hooks

Patched upstream files — per-voice oscilloscope, every site marked
"REWAMP SCOPE" (grep -rn "REWAMP SCOPE" src/ after a resync, re-apply):
  src/chips/opn_chip_base.h, .tcc   per-channel outputs after each native
                                    tick, one hook per OUTPUT frame
  src/chips/mame_opn2.{h,cpp}       rewampChannelOut (MAME YM2612)
  src/chips/mame/mame_ym2612fm.c    rewamp_opn_mame2612_chout (out_fm[])
  src/chips/nuked_opn2.{h,cpp}      rewampChannelOut (Nuked OPN2, ch_out x32)
  src/opnmidi_midiplay.cpp          noteUpdFreq: chip channel -> MIDI channel
Other emulators (GENS, YMFM, NP2, MAME YM2608) keep the default (no
capture): notes and mute only.
Oracle: scripts/verify_opnmidi.sh (correlation of the voices' sum with the
mix: MAME 0.98, Nuked 0.95).
